scripts.rebuild: rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf .wrangler && rm -rf packages/AzurLaneData && rm -rf apps/web/node_modules && rm -rf packages/dev/node_modules && rm -rf packages/gsheets2img/node_modules && rm -rf packages/compress/node_modules && rm -rf packages/image-downloader/node_modules && rm -rf apps/web/dist && rm -rf apps/web/.astro && bun run update
scripts.reset: bun run rebuild && bun run devtools && bun run build
scripts.devtools: bun run submodule && bun --filter dev main && bun run format
scripts.check: bun --filter frontend check && bun --filter dev check && bun --filter gsheets2img check && bun --filter compress check && bun --filter image-downloader check

scripts.deploy: bun run cf-build && bunx wrangler deploy
